paragraphs.text: Ms Rina Lim asked how long patients wait for a first appointment at public specialist clinics. The Minister for Health, Dr Aaron Koh, said the median wait fell from forty days to thirty-two days over the past year, and that four more clinics now offer evening appointments.
Waiting times for each clinic will be published from next year, so that patients can choose where to go.

The Community Transport Bill will require community bus operators to publish an accessibility plan every year, the Minister for Transport, Ms Grace Ho, told the House. Answering Mr Daniel Ong, she said small operators will have a two-year transition period and a template from the Land Transport Authority.
The Bill was read a second time and committed to a Committee of the whole House.

Mr Kumar Raj asked whether household energy rebates will continue after December 2026. In a written answer, the Minister for Sustainability, Dr Mei Chen, said they will be extended to March 2027 for households in one- to three-room flats, benefiting about 300,000 households.
